entry.title: Książ Lion Gate at Świebodzice
entry.note: The park-side photograph looks through the gate toward the mapped Wałbrzyska and Kasztanowa junction. The road-side photograph confirms the opposite approach and inward-facing lions. Foundations and wall plinths follow retained terrain, and the open leaves sit beside the path.
